title: Journey stability & Japan Ready audio
changes: Fixed a Journey rendering loop that could freeze or crash the app when Continue Journey was pressed.
Stopped the Journey timeline observer from reacting to its own DOM updates.
Made Journey storage use the app's profile storage key, including admin/test mode.
Made Japan Ready cheat-sheet speech more reliable on Android/Chrome by handling delayed voices and the cancel/resume speech race.
Japan Ready remains a separate path.
